subject.title: [Bug]:  cron scheduled wake to main session is skipped (status=skipped, error="disabled"), so the main agent is never woken

question: Which open fix PR should be the canonical path for the main-session cron skipped/disabled bug?
rationale: The issue now has two live closing PRs with different cron/heartbeat semantics, and choosing between bypassing per-agent heartbeat gates versus keeping queued events after a disabled immediate wake is a maintainer review choice.

options.title: Choose one canonical fix PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101584 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101668, then land the one that preserves heartbeat intent and proves the recurring cron run history is fixed.

options.title: Request a combined replacement
options.body: If neither PR covers both direct and queued cron wake behavior cleanly, ask for a narrow combined patch with the relevant regression tests.

options.title: Pause both PRs
options.body: If per-agent heartbeat omission should suppress cron wakes, keep this issue open for an explicit product decision instead of accepting either current fix shape.

recommendation.title: Choose one canonical fix PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101584 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101668, then land the one that preserves heartbeat intent and proves the recurring cron run history is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged disabled-heartbeat cron retry work is the closest prior owner signal for this exact skipped/disabled area.
